quarterly_data.signal: Amazon and Wiwynn announced an expansion of Wiwynn's manufacturing operations in Socorro, Texas (Wiwynn's first manufacturing site in the U.S.), expected to create nearly 1,000 new advanced manufacturing jobs by the end of 2027. The company says the continued investment supports growing customer demand and will bring total employment at the facility to over 2,500 next year, with further growth to 4,000 employees expected at full capacity. CEO William Lin: through 'our over $1.6 billion investment in the Texas facility' Wiwynn is expanding its ability to address the growing demand of U.S. customers.
quarterly_data.figure: over $1.6 billion Texas investment; nearly 1,000 new jobs by end of 2027; over 2,500 employees next year; 4,000 at full capacity
